paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
coupling_convention: d_n oscillation amplitude in e*cm (limit on dn-(mu_n/mu_Hg)dHg)
notes: Paper searches for axion-induced oscillating neutron EDM and axion-wind effect. Main results are limits on CG/fa (axion-gluon, GeV^-1) and CN/fa (axion-nucleon, GeV^-1) over ma 1e-24 to 1e-17 eV. The directly measured quantity is the oscillation amplitude of dn-(mu_n/mu_Hg)dHg, with baseline sensitivity ~3-4e-26 e*cm across the sensitive band (Fig 2). Peak sensitivity fa/CG~1e21 GeV (CG/fa~1e-21 GeV^-1) for ma<1e-23 eV; fa/CN~4e5 GeV (CN/fa~2.5e-6 GeV^-1) for 1e-19-1e-17 eV. Ambiguous coupling type: the gluon coupling maps to nEDM (AxionEDM) but axis is CG/fa in GeV^-1, and there is also an axion-nucleon (AxionNeutron) result.
